messages:
julia.support: Escalation from NovaApps — tenant reports they can no longer run a pinned model after our scheduled KMS key rotation. Customer is effectively locked out of model inference.

maria.kim: got the support ticket #43421. Customer says console shows 403 on model endpoint and embeddings tests fail. Billing page unaffected.

chris.lee: any recent RBAC changes for that tenant? I only saw the KMS rotation window 03:15 UTC in infra ops.

samir.verma: infra ops rotated the key alias per rotation policy. There was a follow-up to rebind service-account -> key-binding but I didn't see that executed for NovaApps specifically.

julia.support: customer logs show this error from our runtime:
```
error=AccessDenied, msg="Failed to decrypt model key", key_id="projects/creds/keys/keys-1234", svc_account="svc-novaapps@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

irene.m: that looks like the tenant's service account lost kms:decrypt on the new key version. Could be because alias changed and we rotated to a new key without updating the binding.

chris.lee: checking audit logs now — ops-bot, can you pull the KMS binding change and last iam.bindRole events for that svc account? ticket shows 1976543180 for rotation.

ops-bot: Audit snippet:
```
1976543179  iam.bindRole  principal=infra-ops@redwood  resource=key/keys-1234  role=kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
1976543180  kms.rotateKey  principal=infra-ops@redwood  resource=key/keys-1234  result=success
1976543205  iam.setPolicy  principal=automation-bot@redwood  resource=key/keys-1234  result=removedBinding svc-novaapps@redwood
```

maria.kim: oh — automation-bot removed bindings as part of a cleanup rule that matched an old alias pattern. That explains removal.

samir.verma: workaround: re-add kms:decrypt binding for svc-novaapps on key/keys-1234, then restart the tenant inference workers to refresh cached credentials. I can do that if we approve.

irene.m: approve. Also we need to document this: runbook should include verifying tenant-specific service account bindings after rotation and a quick detect rule for any removeBinding events targeting tenant svc accounts.

chris.lee: done — I patched the key policy and restarted workers for NovaApps. Customer confirmed inference calls succeeded at 1976543289.

julia.support: NovaApps on the line — they report access restored. Passing customer note: "thanks, we've resumed traffic; please advise root cause and prevention steps."

maria.kim: next steps: 1) add an alert for iam.setPolicy that removes kms bindings for any service accounts with tenant suffixes; 2) add a post-rotation validation job that checks a sample of tenants for decrypt success; 3) update runbook.

samir.verma: adding to infra backlog and creating a small eval job. I'll create postmortem template and link to ticket #43421.

irene.m: quick vulnerability note — double-check automation-bot rules to avoid regex overreach. If a rule matched alias patterns broadly, it could hit other tenants.

julia.support: thanks all. I'll send a one-paragraph summary to the customer and close the escalation once the postmortem is linked. Assigning owners: samir (root cause & fix), chris (immediate rollback & alert), irene (runbook + automation-bot rule review), maria (customer comms).
